scope: FEATUREFINDER/Biosaur2Algorithm.h/.cpp: every public and private member; the TOPP wrapper FeatureFinderLFQ is recorded in topp_feature_finder_lfq_provenance.json
method: Executed differential against the Linux x86_64 Release build. driver.cpp reaches the private helpers with #define private public around the algorithm header and prints every double as its IEEE-754 bit pattern: per case the input digest, status, every hill (summary and a digest of its per-point vectors), peptide feature, FeatureMap entry, the processed experiment and both TSV exports; the helper probes; the Boost averagine table; the defaults. tests/biosaur2.rs reproduces every record bit for bit.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed, Linux x86_64 Release) for every compared record; tier 3 for the transcribed class-test literals; tier 4 for the native refusals, atomicity, the combination ceiling, thread determinism and the independent statrs check of the averagine table

The driver, the scripts, the generated inputs and the raw outputs live under ../oracle/FF4-biosaur2 (relative to the repository root); the entries below pin them. gen_cases.py writes cases/, make_table.py writes src/analysis/featurefinder/biosaur2/averagine_table.rs from results/helpers_oracle.tsv, stage_fixtures.py and stage_topp_fixtures.py copy the fixtures.
cpp_issue_candidates: buildFastMzLookup_ bins hills by htol and searches one bin either side, so isotope candidates beyond about 2*htol ppm are never seen and an itol above twice htol is not honoured
cosineCorrelation1D_'s omp simd reduction makes the correlation (and the pattern ranking) depend on the compiler's vector width; the SSE2 Release build sums even and odd positions separately
static_cast<int>(mz / mz_step) and the ion-mobility and averagine quotients are undefined for a small positive htol or paseftol, which the parameters accept

processFAIMSGroup_ counts FAIMS or drift-time spectra without per-peak ion mobility as ion-mobility data and logs 'Applying PASEF/TIMS centroiding' and 'N peaks -> 0 centroided clusters' though nothing is centroided (executed)
the header documents Hill::drift_times and ion_mobilities as empty if not available; both hold one entry per peak (-1); centroidPASEFData_ documents mz_step as [out]
performInitialIsotopeCalibration_'s result is discarded; checkIsotopeValleySplit_ is never called
run() modifies the stored experiment before it can throw
the parameter descriptions of pasefmini and convex_hulls contain U+2013, which the ParamXML writer emits as raw UTF-8 in a document it declares ISO-8859-1 (executed -write_ini)
